items.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995
items.q: Did you know — you know Ernie Fields then? I’m sure you know him. ... I think Little Ernie, I think somebody told me Ernie was still living. ... Melvin Moore told me this. Did you know a singer by the name of Melvin Moore? He used to sing with Ernie Fields for a long time...

ctx.x: You know I spent some time in that area myself, when you talk about Tulsa, Oklahoma, I spent ten years in Tulsa. And I noticed that the feel is different. It’s more relaxed, it’s got a nice bounce to it, but it doesn’t sound so jumpy and hurried. And it’s still kind of like that.
Did you know — you know Ernie Fields then? I’m sure you know him.
